title: Own The Day, Own Your Life

questions.q: Why does Marcus recommend water before coffee?
a: You wake dehydrated after hours without drinking
Coffee absorbs water from your cells
Water speeds up caffeine absorption
It prevents you from eating breakfast
questions.why: Lesson 1 notes we lose about a pound of water overnight, so we wake up dehydrated.

questions.q: What does the 2008 study say beats coffee and extra sleep for afternoon productivity?
a: A nap
A short walk
A cold shower
A protein snack
questions.why: Lesson 2 cites a 2008 British study in which naps beat caffeine and extra sleep.

questions.q: What is Marcus's total health optimization about?
a: Training for overall health rather than one body part
Building muscle as fast as possible
Following one exercise program for life
Focusing on appearance above all else
questions.why: Lesson 3 describes total health optimization as training for overall health, not one body part.

questions.q: What does Marcus say about his car accident?
a: It happened for him, not to him
It ruined his career permanently
It made him quit his company
It taught him to avoid driving
questions.why: The overview recounts Marcus saying the accident happened for him, not to him.

questions.q: What does the summary warn about bodybuilders who focus on one muscle group?
a: They sacrifice other areas and pay for it later
They gain strength more evenly
They avoid injury through specialization
They inspire better overall habits
questions.why: Lesson 3 warns that focusing on one muscle group sacrifices other areas and shows up later.
